profiles.at: Recommended printing settings; p. 1: Nozzle note
profiles.abrasion: A wear-resistance nozzle, such as hardened steel and ruby nozzle, is highly recommended to be used with Fiberon™ PA612-ESD.

notes.text: Print settings: "Drying Settings: 100˚C for 10h (Only if the material has absorbed moisture)" Tips: "Store and print under dry conditions (relative humidity below 20%); dry at 100°C for 10 hours before use and feed from a dry box or heated filament dryer during printing."
